In mathematics, the '''Hurwitz class number''' ''H''(''N''), introduced by [[Adolf Hurwitz]],  is a modification of the class number of positive definite binary quadratic forms of discriminant&nbsp;–''N'', where forms are weighted by 2/''g'' for ''g'' the order of their automorphism group, and where ''H''(0)&nbsp;=&nbsp;[[1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + ⋯|–1/12]].

{{harvtxt|Zagier|1975}} showed that the Hurwitz class numbers are coefficients of a [[mock modular form]] of weight 3/2.
